Pressing and dragging the mouse pushes and swirls nearby particles. It is not GSAP-driven — the physics integrate every frame inside p5's draw loop.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras un fondo interactivo de partículas que caen y reaccionan al arrastrar el ratón, ideal para un hero o CTA de contacto llamativo.

components.title: Lusion Landing Page Reveal
components.description: Full-screen preloader-to-content reveal that plays once on load. Three digit columns spin upward with gsap.to (power2.inOut) to count toward 100 while a two-segment loader bar fills, then at ~6s the digits lift away and the loader rotates, scales 40x and flies off-screen (power2.inOut); the black loading screen fades out and the 'Website Content' heading slides up from behind a white revealer using a staggered gsap.to on the h1 elements.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como preloader de entrada con contador y barra de carga que termina revelando un titular grande al desvanecerse la pantalla negra.

components.title: Silhouette Page Transition
components.description: Full-page route transition where clicking a nav link runs a GSAP timeline that wipes 20 vertical blocks across the screen (scaleX stagger), then draws an SVG logo via strokeDashoffset and fills it before the incoming page is revealed with a reverse block wipe. Page headings animate in with a SplitText masked-character stagger and the archive route uses Lenis smooth scroll.
components.useWhen: Cuando navegas entre páginas y quieres una transición cinematográfica: cortina de bloques y un logo que se dibuja para tapar el cambio de ruta.

components.title: Magnetic Spotlight Marquee
components.description: Infinitely auto-scrolling image marquee strip (gsap.to with x-wrap modifiers) that magnetically follows the cursor's vertical position on mousemove, lerped in gsap.ticker (0.05 ease) and clamped 175px from the section edges. SplitText-split heading and copy lines rise out of the strip's way as it descends and receive a gaussian velocity 'wake' offset, while the content sits in mix-blend-mode: difference over the passing images.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una banda de imágenes en scroll infinito que sigue el cursor, con titular superpuesto en mix-blend, como sección destacada de agencia o portfolio.

components.title: Mask Reveal On Scroll
components.description: As each image row enters the viewport, a 3x3 grid of clip-path masks unveils the picture piece by piece: GSAP injects nine overlay divs per image and a ScrollTrigger timeline (start 'top 75%') animates their clip-path polygons from collapsed points to full cells in a diagonal wave (power2.out, 0.5s, staggered), producing a tiled mosaic reveal. Lenis drives smooth scrolling synced to ScrollTrigger.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras que las imágenes aparezcan en un mosaico de celdas con clip-path al hacer scroll, con scroll suave Lenis en una galería editorial.

components.title: Mat Voyce Scroll Animation
components.description: A pinned scroll section (scrub over 5x viewport height, Lenis-smoothed) drives a horizontal reel of four huge italic project titles while ten rounded image cards fly toward the viewer from deep translateZ. A single ScrollTrigger onUpdate maps progress to the titles' x offset and, per card, staggers each one's Z position and scale; scroll velocity adds a springy layered x-jitter to two color copies of every title for a Mat Voyce style kinetic-type effect.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una sección de scroll con tipografía cinética gigante y tarjetas de imágenes que entran en 3D; ideal para mostrar proyectos con energía.

components.title: MaximaTherapy Sticky Cards
components.description: Scroll-pinned hero (700svh of scrub scroll, Lenis-smoothed) where a stack of cards rises into view while the headline exits upward; past the halfway mark the front card 3D-flips with an elastic rotationY to reveal four tilted colored cards, which then get dismissed upward one by one with increasing rotation across staggered progress ranges.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un hero de apertura con scroll largo donde una pila de cartas sube y la frontal se voltea en 3D para revelar servicios o valores.

components.title: Maxmilkin Orbit Text Preloader
components.description: Portfolio preloader where eight words ride concentric SVG circular orbits, stretching and sliding around their rings via animated textPath textLength/startOffset while the whole SVG wobbles in random ±25° rotations and a central counter tweens 0 to 100. After ~6s the orbit words fade out ring by ring, the loader dissolves away and the hero reveals with a 1.25→1 background zoom-out and word-masked SplitText copy sliding up on a custom ease. Plays automatically on page load.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras una pantalla de carga sobria y tipográfica que orbite palabras alrededor de un contador antes de revelar el hero.

components.title: Media Monks Hover
components.description: A dark film-studio work-list where hovering each project flips the whole panel to that project's pastel tint and lifts every row's opacity via CSS transitions, while a tilted strip of film-still previews behind the text repositions (top/left) and swaps its active card to reveal the matching project, plus an arrow icon that slides in from the left edge of a pill button on the hovered row.
components.useWhen: Úsalo en una lista de proyectos/trabajos donde cada fila, al pasar el ratón, cambia el fondo y revela un preview animado detrás del texto.

components.title: Meetings Arc Slider
components.description: A click-driven fullscreen slider showing three cards on an arc (prev/active/next); clicking a side card or a list item fires a 2s GSAP CustomEase 'hop' transition where cards orbit into position while their inner images counter-rotate, the incoming card's clip-path opens from a centered window, the outgoing card scales to zero and fades, and the title swaps via per-character span y-staggers. A blurred background preview image cross-fades and a slow CSS pan animation runs continuously.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como galería o showcase a pantalla completa donde tres tarjetas en arco rotan con una transición dramática de clip-path al hacer clic.

components.title: Ember & Rye Fullscreen Menu
components.description: A minimal Menu button expands a right-docked panel to a fullscreen overlay of five vertical menu columns (Eat, Grill, Burgers, Visit, Order) for a wood-fired burger house, with per-letter staggered reveals of oversized serif labels and image clip-path reveals on hover. Triggered by clicking Menu/Close; GSAP tweens the panel width with a CustomEase 'hop' curve and staggers letter spans with power3.out.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras un menu de pantalla completa tipo revista, con columnas verticales, tipografia gigante e imagenes que aparecen al pasar el cursor.

components.title: Text Displacement Cursor Repel
components.description: Headings and paragraph text are split into individual letters and words that get pushed away from the cursor within a 150px radius, the displacement force scaling with proximity. Pure requestAnimationFrame with per-element lerp smoothing (no GSAP) drives the elastic follow-and-settle motion via CSS transforms on mousemove.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras que titulares y párrafos reaccionen al cursor, empujando letras y palabras con un movimiento elástico suave sin librerías.

components.title: Merle Photo-Studio Hover Index
components.description: A dark full-screen index for a photography & art-direction studio where hovering a series in the left list crossfades a full-bleed background image and reveals a positioned project preview (image, title, tags, description). GSAP tweens a clip-path wipe on the preview image plus staggered x/y + opacity transforms driven by per-item layout variants, all triggered on mouseenter/mouseleave.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras una landing o índice de proyectos donde al pasar el cursor por una lista se revela una imagen de fondo y una ficha del proyecto.

components.title: Moblinks Interactive Logo
components.description: Depth-tunnel hero around a 3D logo: six stacked layers, five of them with SVG mask cutouts at decreasing sizes (mask-composite: subtract), trail the cursor on mousemove. A gsap.ticker buffers the cursor path and each layer reads a progressively older position (8-frame stagger) smoothed with lerp, creating a cascading parallax tunnel with per-layer drop shadows.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un hero de marca inmersivo: un logo 3D dentro de un túnel de profundidad en capas que sigue el cursor con parallax.

components.title: Modular Carousel
components.description: A click-driven modular image carousel: each click advances a horizontal strip of slide titles via a 2s gsap.to power4.out tween, while two split image panels (top/bottom, shaped with CSS clip-path polygons) are freshly injected and revealed by animating their clip-path and scale from collapsed to full with a 0.15s stagger. Hovering the image widens the top/bottom clip-path windows; excess stacked images are trimmed on tween complete.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para un carrusel a pantalla completa donde cada clic avanza títulos y revela la imagen partida en dos con clip-path animado.

components.title: Camille Mormal Grid Reveal
components.description: An on-load intro reveal built from a single GSAP timeline: five vertical columns of images slide in from off-screen top/bottom (alternating positive and negative staggers per column with a power4.inOut ease), then the whole image grid scales up 6x while the nav links, masked hero title, slide counter and footer preview thumbnails slide up into their clip-path frames and the two '+' icons scale from 0 to 1. Plays automatically once on page load.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como intro de un portfolio o landing creativa donde una rejilla de imágenes se ensambla y escala revelando el hero a pantalla completa.

components.title: Mosaic Flip Hover Effect
components.description: A 12x9 grid of 3D cube tiles displays an image sliced via per-tile background-position, each tile gently floating on the z-axis in an endless 'breathe' loop. Hovering a project link flips every tile 180deg on rotateY with a center-out grid stagger (power3.inOut), revealing the hovered project's image on the cubes' hidden faces; leaving the list flips back to the default image.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un índice de proyectos donde al pasar el cursor por cada enlace un mosaico 3D de cubos gira desde el centro y revela su portada.

components.title: Mouse Trail with SVG and GSAP
components.description: Seven layered SVG polyline paths in a rainbow palette follow the cursor as an interpolated, snake-like ribbon trail. A single mousemove listener eases a shared smooth pointer toward the cursor via gsap.to (duration 0.5, power2.out), and a requestAnimationFrame loop prepends that point to each path's history (40 to 10 points per layer) to redraw the M/L path data every frame, producing staggered trailing tails.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un rastro de cursor colorido y juguetón tipo cinta/serpiente que siga el ratón sobre un fondo llamativo.

components.title: NakedCity Films Navbar Scroll Animation
components.description: A fixed, centered 16:9 navbar window (cream panel with nav links over a full-viewport fixed image) expands from 50% width to fullscreen as you scroll the first viewport, scrubbed via ScrollTrigger onUpdate with gsap.utils.interpolate while a paused Flip timeline flies the oversized logo from bottom-center to a pinned top position. Lenis drives the smooth scrolling.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una intro de hero donde un navbar central se expande a pantalla completa al hacer scroll, revelando una imagen cinematográfica de fondo.

components.title: Scroll Animated Text Reveal
components.description: A scroll-driven, word-by-word text reveal where Lenis smooth scroll feeds GSAP ScrollTrigger, which pins each text section over four viewport heights and, via manual per-word progress math in onUpdate, fades words in behind a grey highlight pill that then dissolves to expose the letters; select keywords reveal inside colored rounded pills, and past 70% progress the sequence re-highlights the words in reverse.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras revelar un párrafo palabra por palabra con píldoras de resaltado al hacer scroll, fijando la sección con scroll suave.

components.title: Line-by-Line Text Reveal
components.description: A scroll-driven line-by-line text reveal. GSAP SplitText breaks each heading and paragraph into masked lines, gsap.set pushes them to y:100%, and a ScrollTrigger fired once at 'top 75%' tweens them back to y:0% (duration 1, stagger 0.1, power4.out); the hero headline runs on load with a 0.5s delay. Lenis provides smooth scrolling.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras que titulares y párrafos aparezcan línea por línea con máscara al hacer scroll, en una landing editorial y sobria.

components.title: Next.js View Transitions
components.description: A multi-page portfolio where clicking a nav link fires a full-page transition built on the native View Transitions API: the outgoing page slides up and fades to 20% opacity while the incoming page is revealed from the bottom via an animated clip-path, both over 1.5s with a cubic-bezier(0.87,0,0.13,1) ease. Each destination also runs its own GSAP intro on mount, the home headline reveals character-by-character and the info paragraph reveals line-by-line (SplitType, power4.out y-translate).
components.useWhen: Úsalo para transiciones entre páginas de un portfolio: la saliente sube y se desvanece mientras la nueva se revela con clip-path desde abajo.

components.title: Nite Riot Landing Page Reveal
components.description: Autoplay landing-page intro: a black overlay reveals a gradient-fill logo and staggered project/location lists, then a centered 3x3 image grid clips open and rapidly cycles through random fashion photos. The outer cells clip away and the central hero image scales up (clip-path zoom) while two banner images pop and rotate outward, the nav drops in, and masked SplitType word reveals push in the intro copy and title. Runs on DOMContentLoaded via three parallel GSAP timelines with a custom 'hop' CustomEase.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como intro de una landing de agencia creativa o moda cuando quieras un revelado dramático con rejilla de fotos que baraja y hace zoom a una imagen hero.

components.title: Fullscreen Portfolio Menu
components.description: A fullscreen overlay navigation that toggles open on clicking the burger button: a GSAP timeline sweeps a clip-path polygon over the whole viewport on a power4.inOut ease, then staggers the oversized menu items up from a y offset with power4.out, grows a CSSRulePlugin-animated underline on the active item, and fades the social sub-nav up into place. Clicking again reverses the same timeline.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para un menú overlay a pantalla completa que se abre con un botón burger, con enlaces gigantes revelados en cascada y subrayado animado del ítem activo.

components.title: Nordquantique Scroll
components.description: A scroll-driven pixelated block transition between full-bleed sections. Each image section is 200vh tall and overlaid with two grids of 4 rows x 16 blocks (top and bottom); a scrubbed ScrollTrigger per row maps scroll progress, plus a per-row delay and a gsap.utils.shuffle randomized per-block offset, to each block's opacity so the top blocks dissolve away to reveal the photo while the bottom blocks build up to cover it as the section scrolls through the viewport.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para transiciones a pantalla completa entre secciones donde una foto se revela con un efecto de píxeles/bloques al hacer scroll.

components.title: O'Shane Howard Landing Page

components.title: Outfit Landing Page Reveal

components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando lances una landing de moda o archivo y quieras una intro a pantalla completa con contador y fotos apiladas antes de revelar el hero.

components.title: Outline Text Filled by Media
components.description: A pinned stage where a giant word sits hollow — stroked, transparent fill — over a photograph, and a scroll-driven wipe uncovers a second copy of the same word filled with that photograph via `background-clip: text`. Two pixel-aligned copies rather than one element that changes: `-webkit-text-stroke` with a transparent fill and a clipped background are different paint paths, and any crossfade between them flickers on the sub-pixel edge of every letter, while two stacked copies with a `clip-path` wipe are exact, cheap and reversible. Both copies share a single grid cell and identical typography — nothing may differ but colour, stroke and clip, because a one-pixel drift shows the outline as a ghost beside the fill and the effect is dead. The fill image is set from JS off the background's own `src`, so the letters are in register with what is behind them and read as a window cut into the photograph. The wipe completes at 78% of the track so the finished word lands while the section is still on screen. Dressed as a dance season: Young Serif + Geologica, deep teal and bone.

components.title: Meristem Overlay Menu

components.title: Oversized Year, Counter-Scrolled

Each band clips horizontally because the numeral is deliberately wider than the viewport. Smoothed by Lenis; reduced motion parks every numeral centred. The demo is dressed as a Gotland ceramics studio: Vollkorn + Martian Mono, oat and kiln-black with an ember accent.
components.useWhen: Cuando hay una historia con fechas y quieres que el año se lea como atmósfera y no como un dato en una tabla.

components.title: P10 Landing Page Reveal

components.title: Block Grid Page Transitions

components.useWhen: Cuando la página apila secciones de colores planos y los cortes rectos entre ellas la hacen parecer una plantilla.

components.title: Sidebar Slide-Out Menu
components.description: Clicking the bottom-right 'Get the Overlay' toggle slides a column of three cards in from the right edge (right: -110% to 0%) with a 0.075s GSAP stagger on a power4.out ease, while the page content blurs to 15px; clicking any card reverses the tween to slide the cards back out and unblur. Cards expand their copy and swap colours on CSS hover.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un panel lateral con tarjetas que entran escalonadas desde la derecha y desenfocan el fondo al abrirse.

components.title: 3D Scroll Scanner Experience
components.description: A full-page scroll experience where a Three.js GLTF model floats and rotates as you scroll, its X-rotation mapped to scroll progress via a Lenis-fed render loop. In a pinned scanner section, a ScrollTrigger onEnter handler plays a scan sound, spins the model a full turn with GSAP, then shrinks it and the scan frame to zero; scrolling back reverses the reveal.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para presentar un producto 3D que flota y rota con el scroll y se "escanea" al fijarse una sección con sonido y animación GSAP.

components.title: SofiHealth Product Scroll Animation
components.description: A pinned, scrub-driven scroll section where a Three.js GLTF shaker model spins on its Y-axis while a single ScrollTrigger onUpdate handler maps scroll progress to sliding headers, an expanding circular clip-path mask, and staggered SplitText tooltip reveals. Lenis smooth-scroll feeds ScrollTrigger, and a separate ScrollTrigger reveals the split header characters on enter.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para presentar un producto 3D que rota con el scroll mientras aparecen titulares y tooltips en una sección fija.

components.title: SpencerGabor Magnetic Cards
components.description: A fanned stack of four cards centered on screen reacts magnetically to the cursor: mouse velocity within a 500px proximity radius (cubic falloff) pushes and tilts the cards, with neighbor influence and an elastic spring-and-friction return to their resting fan layout. Custom physics driven per-frame by gsap.ticker and gsap.set, triggered by moving the mouse over the section.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un abanico de cartas centrado que reaccione al cursor con física magnética, empuje e inclinación elástica de resorte.

components.title: Stacked Alternating Marquees
components.description: Four full-width marquee rows stacked with no gap, running continuously in ALTERNATING directions at non-harmonic speeds (26/34/30/22), each row inverting the palette so the opposition is visible at a glance. The rows also lean into the scroll: a single ScrollTrigger reads `getVelocity()` and feeds a push term that speeds each row up in its own direction, decaying at 0.92 per frame so stopping does not leave them racing. Written as one `gsap.ticker` loop rather than CSS `@keyframes` precisely because a CSS animation runs on its own clock and cannot know the scroll exists. The strip content is cloned once at runtime (the copy `aria-hidden`, so categories are not read twice) and the transform wraps at exactly half the measured width, re-measured on `load` and on `fonts.ready` because images change that width. Dressed as a print fair: Archivo Black + Syne Mono, teal, cream and red.
components.useWhen: Cuando hay una lista de categorías o reclamos que se leen de un vistazo y quieres densidad y ritmo en vez de una rejilla.

components.title: Steelworks Landing Page Reveal
components.description: On-load preloader and hero reveal: a white progress bar scales across a dark overlay that wipes away via clip-path, five small rotated images glide in as a centered row with CustomEase, then the side images fly off-screen while the center one expands to a fullscreen hero as nav, headline and social links reveal line by line with SplitText masks.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras una intro de carga con imágenes editoriales que aterrizan y una portada que crece a pantalla completa con títulos línea a línea.

components.title: Sticky Stacking Cards on Scroll
components.description: Full-width service cards that pin at 35% of the viewport on scroll and stack under each incoming card: every pinned card's inner wrapper is scrubbed upward by a decreasing multiple of 14vh, producing a layered peel effect, while the intro headline stays pinned (no pin spacing) between the first and last card. Driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger with Lenis smooth scrolling.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando presentes servicios o secciones en tarjetas a pantalla completa que se fijan y se apilan una sobre otra al hacer scroll.

components.title: Sticky Cards ScrollTrigger
components.description: A stack of full-screen sections is pinned one after another with ScrollTrigger (pin, pinSpacing:false, scrub) so each card holds in place while the next scrolls over it, and each pinned image scales from 1 down to 0.5 as the following section approaches. The hero heading fades its opacity from 1 to 0 across the first 400vh of scroll.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una galería de imágenes a pantalla completa donde cada tarjeta se fija y encoge al hacer scroll, revelando la siguiente con transición suave.

components.title: Ashfall Sticky Cards Scroll
components.description: Five image cards stacked in a centered container are revealed one at a time while a Lenis-driven, ScrollTrigger-pinned section (4 viewport heights) is scrubbed: each front card scales down to 0.5 and rotates 10deg while its image zooms to 1.5, and the next card slides up from y:100% to y:0% to take its place.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para revelar 3-5 imágenes o proyectos apilados uno a uno al hacer scroll, con cartas que escalan y rotan sobre un fondo oscuro.

components.title: Sticky Image Minimap
components.description: A tall scrolling column of full-size images paired with a sticky vertical minimap of thumbnails; a GSAP ScrollTrigger created per image fires onToggle as each image passes the viewport center (start 'top center', end 'bottom center'), and gsap.to animates the matching thumbnail's border, opacity, scale (1.3) and z-index to highlight it. Triggered by scroll.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una galería vertical de imágenes grandes con un minimapa fijo de miniaturas que resalta la imagen visible al hacer scroll.

components.title: Stories Slideshow
components.description: A fullscreen Stories-style slideshow that auto-advances every 4s and can be stepped forward/back by clicking the left/right half of the screen. GSAP tweens drive an animated clip-path image reveal, a scale-and-rotate crossfade between story images, a segmented progress bar per story, sliding masked text swaps for the profile name and title, and a blurred custom cursor that follows the pointer and reads Prev/Next. Presented as 'Facet', a directory spotlighting independent design studios and their founders.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras un carrusel a pantalla completa tipo Stories con auto-avance, cursor personalizado y transiciones de imagen con clip-path y escala.

components.title: Story World Carousel Slider
components.description: A fullscreen click-advanced carousel where each click slides the current image left (x:-500) while the next slide is revealed by animating its clip-path from a collapsed right edge to full, its image easing in from x:250. All tweens use a custom GSAP 'hop' CustomEase, and a horizontal 'pm' timeline animates flex-grow so the active hour label expands while the others collapse, looping infinitely.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para un carrusel de imágenes a pantalla completa que avanza al hacer clic, con revelado por clip-path y una línea de tiempo de horas animada.

components.title: StudioDialect 3D Spiral Image Gallery
components.description: Scroll-driven 3D spiral gallery built with Three.js: 75 curved tiles textured with 10 photos wind down a five-revolution helix, and a custom shader dims each tile as it turns away from the camera. Lenis scroll velocity spins the spiral (with decay) while scroll progress lerps the camera down through the helix; mouse movement adds a subtle X/Z parallax tilt on desktop.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras una galería de fotos editoriales que se enrolla en una espiral 3D y gira con el scroll, como pieza central inmersiva.

components.title: SVG Scribble Draw-On Image Hover
components.description: A 3x2 grid of square image cards, each overlaid with two oversized scribbled SVG paths. On mouseenter the strokes draw themselves on (strokeDashoffset animated from full path length to 0 via getTotalLength) while their stroke-width swells from 200 to 700, and the card title rises word by word with a SplitText mask; on mouseleave everything reverses.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando tengas una galería de retratos o productos y quieras que cada tarjeta dibuje trazos SVG garabateados al pasar el cursor.

components.title: SVG Stroke Page Transition
components.description: Page transition where two full-screen squiggly SVG paths draw themselves in via animated strokeDashoffset while their stroke-width swells from 200 to 700, wiping the viewport, then keep drawing out as the stroke thins back to reveal the new page. Triggered by clicking the navbar links routing between three hero pages.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras que los cambios de ruta entre páginas se cubran con un barrido de trazo SVG llamativo y de alto contraste al hacer clic en el menú.

components.title: Telescope Image Scroll Animation
components.description: A pinned banner scrubbed over four viewport heights with Lenis smooth scroll: the image container scales up from zero while seven stacked silhouette-masked copies of the same photo grow at staggered scales, creating a telescoping lens-in-lens depth effect. Two intro words slide apart horizontally and the centered headline reveals word-by-word, all driven by a single ScrollTrigger onUpdate reading self.progress.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para un hero de moda o editorial donde una foto se revela con scroll suave y un efecto telescópico de capas enmascaradas por una silueta.

components.title: Telescope Scroll Animation
components.description: 'Afterimage', a pinned spotlight gallery of long-exposure photographs in colored light. Scrolling first splits the 'After / Image' intro text apart and scales a background image up from zero, then scrolls a vertical column of frame titles through a diamond-shaped (telescope) clip-path viewfinder while thumbnails fly along a quadratic bezier arc; the title nearest the viewport center highlights and swaps the full-bleed background image. Driven by a single ScrollTrigger (pin + scrub over 10x viewport height, Lenis-smoothed) whose onUpdate maps scroll progress across phased ranges with gsap.set.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una galería editorial donde el scroll fija la sección y desplaza títulos por un visor con clip-path mientras miniaturas vuelan en arco y cambian el fondo.

components.title: Text Hover Image Ring
components.description: Hovering a highlighted word in the hero paragraph reveals a ring of 11 images that continuously orbits around the cursor. The images fan out on a circle via GSAP: a gsap.ticker loop advances the rotation angle each frame while gsap.to tweens each item's x/y, opacity in and out (0.5s, power1.out) with lerped cursor-following.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras que pasar el cursor sobre palabras clave de un párrafo revele un anillo de imágenes que orbita y sigue al ratón.

components.title: Text Reveal Animation
components.description: Char-level text reveal built on GSAP SplitText: each character slides in from x:100 with a 20-degree skew and fades to place (power3.out, 0.65s), staggered 0.05s by its index within its own line so all lines animate in parallel. Three trigger modes across full-height sections: on page load, on scroll enter (replays entering, resets when scrolled back above), and scrubbed between viewport positions, all under Lenis smooth scrolling.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras que titulares o frases grandes entren carácter a carácter al cargar o al hacer scroll, con look atrevido y tipográfico.

components.title: The Quiet Crowd Landing Reveal
components.description: On page load a GSAP timeline wipes a clip-path preloader and spins a loader, then reveals the hero: heading characters (manually split into spans) slide up with a staggered power4.out tween while a circular hero image scales in and rotates infinitely. Moving the cursor during the load spawns emoji particles that pop in with a back.out ease and drop off-screen.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieres una intro de landing con preloader animado, revelado del titular y una capa lúdica de emojis que caen al mover el cursor.

components.title: TheFirstTheLast Scroll Animation
components.description: A pinned section where six rotated product cards stack up one after another from the bottom of the viewport as you scroll, then fly off toward the top-left corner. A single ScrollTrigger (pin + scrub over 8x viewport height, Lenis-smoothed) drives an onUpdate handler that maps scroll progress to each card's y-entry and staggered x/y exit offset.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para presentar una colección de productos o imágenes que se apilan y salen volando de forma secuencial al hacer scroll en una sección fija.

components.title: ThreeJS Infinite Slider
components.description: Infinite vertical slider built entirely in Three.js (no GSAP): ten textured planes loop endlessly inside a WebGL scene, driven by mouse wheel, drag and touch with lerped smoothing and momentum friction. Scroll velocity bends each plane's vertices along Z with a sine falloff, creating a directional curvature distortion, while an HTML title and counter track the slide closest to center.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para un carrusel vertical de imágenes a pantalla completa con distorsión WebGL al hacer scroll, ideal en portadas editoriales o de moda.

components.title: ThreeJS Curved Distortion Slider
components.description: An infinite horizontal Three.js image slider built from textured PlaneGeometry meshes whose vertices bend into a radial curve as you scroll or drag. Wheel, touch and arrow-key input feed velocity-tracked position and distortion factors that are lerped every frame, so faster flicks warp the slides more and the whole strip wraps seamlessly.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una galería o carrusel horizontal infinito e inmersivo donde las imágenes se curvan y distorsionan en WebGL al hacer scroll o arrastrar.

components.title: ThreeJS 3D Video Gallery
components.description: A Three.js WebGL grid of video-textured planes curved into a parabolic wall, each plane mapped to a looping muted video texture. Mouse movement drives a per-frame requestAnimationFrame loop that applies parallax, oscillation and rotation to every plane, eases the camera lookAt target, and tilts the CSS-3D headline via a cubic-bezier transform.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieres un hero inmersivo con una pared curva de videos en 3D que reacciona al movimiento del raton.

components.title: TrueKind Landing Page Reveal
components.description: A preloader-to-hero landing reveal driven by a single GSAP timeline with a custom 'hop' ease: a two-digit counter rolls through milestone numbers (00, 27, 65, 98, 99) with a staggered vertical roll, the 'KindRoot' logo words slide together, a vertical divider scales up and fades, then two dark blocks wipe upward via clip-path while the background hero image scales from 1.5 to 1 and the nav, masked headline lines, paragraph and CTA pill slide and scale into place. Plays automatically once on page load.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como intro de una landing de skincare o marca natural donde un contador y logo desembocan en un hero a pantalla completa.

components.title: 3D Tunnel Image Slider Carousel
components.description: A full-screen animated monochrome tunnel, rendered as a Three.js fragment-shader plane, sits behind ten framed cinematic film stills laid out along the Z axis inside a CSS perspective container. Smooth scrolling via Lenis feeds a GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub:1 whose onUpdate handlers push each slide's translateZ toward the camera and fade it in through a Z-to-opacity mapping, while the same scroll progress drives the shader's scrollOffset uniform to warp the tunnel in sync. Presented as the showreel of a film and color studio, 'Tunnel Vision'.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una galería o portfolio inmersivo donde las imágenes vuelan hacia la cámara por un túnel de neón animado controlado con el scroll.

components.title: Turbulent Inversion Lens Hover Effect
components.description: A full-viewport Three.js plane renders a portrait through a fragment shader; moving the cursor drives a lerped mask whose radius grows on hover, and inside that circular lens the image is converted to inverted grayscale with animated fBm turbulence jittering the mask edge.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando el cursor deba revelar una lente turbulenta que invierte la imagen a escala de grises sobre un retrato o hero a pantalla completa.

components.title: ScrollTrigger Variable Font Marquee
components.description: Four horizontal image marquees drift sideways as you scroll (gsap.fromTo on x driven by a scrubbed ScrollTrigger), while SplitType splits the interspersed word headings into characters whose variable fontWeight is tweened from 100 to 900 with a staggered, scrubbed ScrollTrigger. Lenis provides the smooth scroll that ScrollTrigger reads.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieres una galería de imágenes en marquees horizontales con títulos cuyo grosor de fuente variable crece al hacer scroll.

components.title: Voku Image Slider
components.description: Infinite horizontal image slider with 9 slides arranged along a cosine arc: each rAF frame computes a modular wrap position per slide and applies it with gsap.set, enlarging and lifting the center slide while side slides shrink to 0.25x and drop along the arc. Driven by mouse wheel and touch drag with a 0.05 lerp, and a caption at the bottom updates to the slide closest to center.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un carrusel coverflow infinito en arco para lucir productos o fotos, con la imagen central destacada y navegable por rueda o arrastre.

components.title: Voltlites Pinned Hero Zoom-Out Reveal
components.description: Hero pinned for four viewport heights where a 3x3 spotlight image grid (300% of the viewport) scales from 1 to 0.5 while each image counter-zooms from 1.25 to 1, a fixed logo shrinks from 6x (2x on mobile) and travels from bottom to top, the footer tagline blurs away, and the SplitText headline plus CTA fade in word by word. A second scrubbed ScrollTrigger on the next section slides the hero up 25% under a darkening overlay as an exit parallax; driven by manual lerp/mapRange in onUpdate with Lenis smooth scroll.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras una portada inmersiva que, al hacer scroll, aleje una rejilla de imágenes para revelar el logo y el titular de la marca.

components.title: VoyeurVerite Scroll Animation
components.description: Pinned hero scrubbed over five viewport heights with four manual phases: the foreground image clips into a central vertical slit while a dark overlay fades in, then rotates to 65deg, scales to zero over sliding background text columns as a red overlay flashes on, and finally two outro images wipe in via clip-path from top and bottom before a SplitText line-masked headline staggers up at 90% progress.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para un hero de apertura cinematográfico que se desarma al hacer scroll, con imágenes en rendija y un titular editorial al final.

components.title: Vucko Scroll Animation
components.description: A tiny centered video preview grows from a 0.25 thumbnail to full scale as the intro section scrolls into view, driven by a GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub timeline (start top bottom, end top 10%) whose onUpdate interpolates translateY, scale, gap and a two-phase title font-size. A requestAnimationFrame loop applies the transforms and adds an eased mouse-follow horizontal parallax, all under Lenis smooth scroll.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras revelar un video o showreel al hacer scroll: crece de miniatura a pantalla completa con parallax de ratón y scroll suave.

components.title: Waabi Scroll Animation
components.description: Hero pinned for 3.5 viewport heights with Lenis smooth scroll and a scrubbed ScrollTrigger whose progress is mapped manually: the header slides up, the copy is revealed word by word via SplitText then fades out, and the fullscreen hero image shrinks into a 150px rounded card. A following section parallax-scrolls four image columns upward at different speeds.
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras una intro editorial con scroll donde el hero se encoge y el texto se revela palabra a palabra antes de una galería con parallax.

components.title: Hero Warp Slider
components.description: A full-screen WebGL hero slider where clicking anywhere advances to the next image through an expanding lens-warp bubble rendered by a Three.js fragment shader. A gsap.fromTo tween drives the shader's uProgress uniform (2.5s, power2.inOut) to grow the distortion sphere, while a GSAP/SplitText timeline slides the per-character title and per-line description text out and back in.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como hero a pantalla completa donde cada clic pasa a la siguiente imagen con una transición de lente warp WebGL y texto animado carácter a carácter.

components.title: Warp Lens Slider
components.description: A full-screen WebGL image slider where clicking anywhere expands a circular lens/bubble mask from the center, warping the incoming photo with a magnifying-glass distortion driven by a custom Three.js fragment shader. GSAP tweens the shader's uProgress uniform (2.5s power2.inOut) while SplitText staggers the title characters and description lines out and back in.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras un slider hero a pantalla completa donde cada cambio de imagen se revela con una distorsion de lente WebGL al hacer click.

components.title: We Go Again
components.description: A three-column documentary-studio film selector where a vertical thumbnail gallery on the right lets you click any item to swap the featured project. On click, GSAP animates the current title/copy/credits lines out (y:-60, power4.in, staggered) while the featured image scales up and collapses away; on completion the details are rebuilt, SplitType re-splits the copy into lines, and the new text (y:40→0, power4.out, stagger) plus image (scale 0→1, power4.out) animate in, while the full-screen blurred background crossfades between the two images.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras un escaparate de proyectos con miniaturas laterales y transiciones animadas de texto e imagen al seleccionar cada elemento.

components.title: WebGL Interactive Gradient
components.description: A full-screen animated WebGL gradient built with Three.js and two custom fragment shaders: a fluid-dynamics shader ping-pongs velocity between two float render targets while a display shader warps a flowing multi-color gradient from that field. A requestAnimationFrame loop advances time-based motion, and mousemove events feed cursor position/velocity into the fluid uniform so the gradient ripples and distorts along the cursor's trail in real time.
components.useWhen: Úsalo como fondo de hero llamativo: un degradado WebGL fluido que se ondula y distorsiona siguiendo el cursor del ratón en tiempo real.

components.title: WeroWallet Spotlight Stroke Draw
components.description: Pinned spotlight section where 13 thick diagonal SVG strokes draw in with a staggered stroke-dashoffset scrub until they cover the screen, swapping the headline and popping three sparkles before un-drawing in reverse. Driven by scroll (ScrollTrigger pin + scrub with Lenis smooth scrolling).
components.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un momento destacado a mitad de página que se pinta con trazos diagonales al scrollear, cubre la pantalla y cambia el titular.

components.title: Wodniack Work Section Scroll
components.description: A pinned scroll section where the word WORK, built from HTML letter divs, streams along four Three.js CatmullRom curves projected to screen space while a warped WebGL plane slides a filmstrip of project images across a scrolling red dot grid. A single ScrollTrigger (pin, scrub, end +=700%) drives the progress that feeds the letter paths, the CanvasTexture card offset and the grid, with Lenis smoothing the scroll and per-frame lerping easing the letters into place.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras una seccion de trabajos con scroll fijado donde el titulo WORK fluye en curvas 3D y las imagenes desfilan en un plano WebGL curvado.

components.title: Karim Saab Fashion Carousel
components.description: A full-screen fashion carousel where a wheel or touch swipe triggers a GSAP transition: the current slide scales down, rotates and flies off while the incoming slide slides in from an animated clip-path polygon; SplitText then reveals the title words and the description, tags, index and link lines with staggered power4 masked upward moves.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para presentar proyectos o una colección de moda a pantalla completa, avanzando de slide en slide con scroll y revelados de texto dramáticos.

components.title: WorkingStiff Animated Teams Section
components.description: Scroll-driven team section with Lenis smooth scroll and two manual scrubbed ScrollTriggers: as the section enters the viewport each member column rises in a stagger while its giant name initial scales up, then the section pins for three viewport heights and the member cards slide in from the right with stagger, rotating from 20deg to 0 and scaling from 0.75 to 1 to cover the initials. Animations are disabled below 1000px width.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para presentar al equipo con estética editorial de moda: nombres gigantes y tarjetas con retrato que entran rotando al hacer scroll.

components.title: YARD Hover Menu
components.description: A large uppercase project list where hovering a menu item swaps its label lines via GSAP top-position tweens and reveals a stacked image preview that follows the cursor. The preview images grow in and out with an animated clip-path polygon on a power3.out ease, while the trailing cursor position is smoothed with a gsap.to on mousemove.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una lista de proyectos o navegación donde al pasar el ratón se revela una previsualización de imagen apilada que sigue al cursor.

components.title: Zajno Landing Page Reveal
components.description: An on-load intro where a centered number counts up to 100, then triggers the landing-page reveal: the scaled-down hero clip-path opens from the bottom while it scales to full size, a dark overlay wipes upward, the hero image un-zooms from scale 2 to 1, and the giant headline's per-character spans rise into place with a stagger. Driven entirely by GSAP timelines chained via onStart/onComplete callbacks, using a CustomEase named 'hop' plus power3/power4 eases.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieras una intro de carga con contador que da paso a un hero con revelado por clip-path y titular animado letra a letra.

components.title: Nuvoro Page Transitions
components.description: A four-view site (home, work, studio, contact) where clicking a nav link runs a native View Transitions API page change: the incoming view is masked by a full-screen clip-path polygon that expands from a thin slit at 75% height to the whole viewport over 2s (cubic-bezier hop ease), while a dark GSAP revealer overlay scales away with a CustomEase 'hop' wipe and the new heading reveals through masked SplitText chars/words/lines on a power4.out stagger. Lenis drives smooth scrolling on the inner pages.
components.useWhen: Cuando quieres transiciones de página fluidas entre secciones, con un barrido clip-path oscuro y titulares que se revelan por líneas al llegar a cada vista.

components.title: Zentry Scroll Animations
components.description: A long scroll story where a section is pinned for 4x the viewport height and every stage is scrubbed by scroll. As you scroll, letters of the intro copy flicker in with a random stagger, a center image expands from a small rectangle to fullscreen via an animated clip-path while its image scales, then a third image opens from a vertical seam and zooms far in before zooming back out, and finally a rotateY(-75deg) headline swings flat to reveal the closing copy. All driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger (pin + scrub) with Lenis smooth scrolling.
components.useWhen: Úsalo para una sección pinneada larga donde el scroll revela imágenes con clip-path, zooms y texto que parpadea, tipo landing inmersiva.

components.title: Zoom-Out Mark Preloader
components.description: A preloader with no veil: the blank white screen IS the interior of the brand's plus-sign mark, blown up until its crossing covers the viewport. A counter ticks 0 to 100 in ink over the white, then the mark zooms out on a logarithmic scale — so the recede reads at a constant rate instead of stalling — and the hero photograph is discovered around it rather than uncovered. The mark lands pixel-exact on the hero's own mark (both are the same two-bar cross, and the landing point and final scale are measured from it, not hard-coded), the two words fly in from opposite edges, and only once they have settled does the mark turn 360 degrees on its axis.
components.useWhen: Cuando la marca tenga un símbolo macizo (una cruz, un asterisco, una barra, un punto) y quieras que la pantalla en blanco de la carga sea el interior de ese símbolo, que se aleja hasta su sitio en el hero en vez de retirarse como un telón.
aliases: la pantalla blanca es el logo
